# opacity reason

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:opacityReason`](gmeow-opacityReason.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/opacityReason>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

Why a frame is opaque to the describing reader (spec §7.6): an encrypt-class codec without a key, a codec the reader lacks, or damage. Functional and REQUIRED (see shapes): opacity without a stated reason is indistinguishable from data loss.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](../classes/gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md) -> [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](../classes/gmeow-OpacityReason.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:opacityReason`](gmeow-opacityReason.md) from [`gmeow:OpaqueFrame`](../classes/gmeow-OpaqueFrame.md) to [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](../classes/gmeow-OpacityReason.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
